summary: 해마다 10건이 안 되게 봄 이동기에 서남해 섬에서 기록되는 길잃은새로, 2008년 4월 28일 신안 홍도에서 제비 무리의 밤 잠자리에 든 수컷이 잡혀 표본으로 확인된 것이 국내 첫 기록이다. 히말라야에서 중국 중남부와 인도차이나 북부에 걸쳐 번식하고, 겨울에는 타이 남서부와 말레이반도 쪽으로 내려간다. 동굴 벽에 진한 침과 이끼로 작은 접시 모양 둥지를 붙여 무리 지어 번식하며, 날면서 공중의 곤충을 잡아먹는다.

points.en: paler grey-brown rump contrasting with the darker back
underparts paler grey-brown than the upperparts

art.subject: Himalayan Swiftlet (Aerodramus brevirostris), adult, as seen in flight over Korean coasts on passage: upperparts plain dark grey-brown, with a slightly paler grey-brown band across the rump; underparts a little paler, dusky grey-brown, palest on the throat; wings blackish-brown; tail short and slightly notched; tiny black bill; dark eye.
art.pose: flying with wings outstretched, seen from below at a slight angle
art.scene: sky above a forested coastal headland in Korea in late spring (May), soft overcast light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, in flight seen squarely from below: small slim swiftlet, head, body and tail in one line, narrow crescent-shaped wings spread out to the sides to their full span and swept back at the wrist, dark underwing, dusky grey-brown underparts paler than the upperparts, tiny black bill, short slightly notched tail, feet tucked against the body

adult, in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, narrow crescent-shaped wings spread out to the sides to their full span and swept back at the wrist, dark blackish-brown wings, crown and back, paler grey-brown band across the rump, short slightly notched dark tail
art.build: Small, slim swift, much smaller than Pacific Swift and about the size of House Swift, with long, narrow, curved wings and a short, slightly notched tail. Bill tiny with a wide gape. Flight fluttering and erratic with frequent glides, often in loose groups over ridges and coasts. Never perches on wires or branches.
avoid: Do not paint a clean white rump band or a white throat; those suit House Swift (Apus nipalensis) or Pacific Swift (Apus pacificus).
Do not paint a deeply forked tail like Pacific Swift or a swallow.
Do not paint white underparts or a reddish throat; that would be a swallow.
